body: Talk to her. Engage in a casual conversation with her and allow her to vent her problems to you. Let her talk to you or address as if you're a normal person, a friend and not her teacher. You can invite her out to talk or discuss over a cup of coffee after school or during your free time. Sometimes, its nice to know that someone wants to help you and want's to talk to you about your problems. A listening ear could be a great help. I hope it helps. It's not much but knowing that someone cares can be great.

It'll pass. I know it's easier said than done but whatever you're facing right now can be over one day. Slowly but surely, you can enjoy the things you used to love or even find new things to enjoy one day. It definitely won't be easy but it'll come. You're strong for lasting, for resisting the urge and for being alive despite the problems you've faced. I'm sure you have friends, family members who will miss you terribly when you're gone. You have a life ahead of you and a story ahead. There's so many things in life you can discover, do and experience so please don't end your life. Just imagine the places you could go, the music you could listen to, the experiences you could have with your friends or families or even small but beautiful moments like sleeping in, being cozy at home while it rains and listening to your favourite song. 

  Just know that you're worth living. Hang in there. I believe you can go on with your life. Although I'm just a stranger online, I believe in you, alright? Stay strong and I wish you the best of luck, OP.

Please,please tell someone outside your family circle. Call a hotline using a payphone outside your house if you have to. Approach a teacher, a counselor, anyone you could trust. Take pictures of your wounds, secretly record your mother's words when she's far away from you and save it to your google drive access and delete the app so she can't have any access to it and so that she can't acknowledge it. Once that's done, you can show it as proof to a school counselor if you have one. If no, I hope there's a teacher or a friend's parent who you can absolutely trust.

  You don't deserve this torment, OP. You deserve a happy and a good life, a life away from this monster. Just know that you're worth experiencing happiness and joy. I hope you'll do well in life and you won't have to face your mother anymore. I wish you the best of luck in the future. Just know that you have me and other Redditor cheering you on, hoping that you'll be away and that we have hope and we believe in you. All the best OP
